purpose: Successor monitoring horizon after aligning the still-open full-2025 Ministry announced-RON reference-auction recovery workflows with their frozen evidence-triggered hold. All six existing trigger identities, dates, evidence windows, AMECO access rules, counterpart-workflow boundaries and prior no-reopen adjudications remain unchanged. This successor adds only an execution boundary for the three unresolved official Ministry acts: active polling remains disabled; recovery workflows are manual-only, require an explicitly declared new-evidence condition, and a run without such new evidence is not scientific progress.

horizons.trigger: Actually observed non-zero BNR policy-rate change in the reserved prospective window.
horizons.action_if_no_trigger: Record unchanged-rate event only; do not inspect MIR response values and return to baseline hold.
horizons.action_if_trigger: Open Stage 1 driver-side diagnostic only. Preserve frozen candidate and beta. Do not inspect same-month MIR response before official release.

downstream_release_gate.rule: The October-reference MIR response may be inspected only on or after 2026-12-02 and only if October contains a non-zero policy-rate event.

horizons.next_check_condition: European Commission publishes the Autumn 2026 full macroeconomic forecast / corresponding AMECO full release.
horizons.trigger: A genuinely new full AMECO vintage materially changes the admissible real-time UBLGBPS structural-primary history or supplies new identification-relevant evidence.
horizons.action_if_release_occurs: Open source discovery/materialisation only under the AMECO migration-readiness protocol: identify the official release and provider dataset identity without guessing, verify UBLGBPS semantics, retain exact bytes/query identity, and preregister a new source-cycle contract before any modelling decision.
horizons.action_before_release: No repeated AMECO probing; remain in baseline hold.

source_access_protocol.target_semantics: Structural balance of general government excluding interest; adjustment based on potential GDP; excessive deficit procedure; percentage of potential GDP at current prices.
discovery_order: Use the official ECFIN Redisstat AMECO browser or the official ECFIN SDMX all-dataflows catalogue to identify the dataset code from provider metadata.
Cross-check the candidate dataset title/structure against the official Redisstat Catalogue TOC and dataflow/DSD metadata.
Verify that the provider metadata contains the frozen UBLGBPS semantic target before constructing any data query.
Only after dataset and target identity are provider-verified may a reproducible data query or bulk payload be retained.
source_access_protocol.rule: After the Autumn 2026 full release exists, identify the Redisstat dataset code from official provider metadata, verify UBLGBPS in provider structural metadata, then retain an exact query/payload. Do not infer the code from chapter 17, ameco17, or third-party mirrors.

horizons.trigger: BNR exposes the exact official 2025-Q2 BLS workbook endpoint or an exact machine-readable time-series/catalog target with matching realised-round semantics.
horizons.action_without_new_evidence: Do not repeat filename/timestamp guessing, indexed search loops or rounded-report substitution.
horizons.action_if_trigger: Reopen source materialisation only; retain exact bytes and semantics before any credit-equation work.

horizons.trigger: An official or reproducible source supplies same-boundary opening principal, realised repriced/refinanced principal and matched old/new effective rates across material debt blocks.
horizons.action_without_new_evidence: Do not reinterpret marginal maturity/refixing indicators as a matched repricing ledger.
horizons.action_if_trigger: Repass the frozen ledger completeness and identification gates only.

horizons.trigger: A changed official ECB/Eurostat/BNR/OECD dataset topology or genuinely new official source supplies the frozen bilateral holder-by-issuer Accounting Spine boundary, including required sectors, instruments, quarterly stocks and financial transactions.

current_known_release_context.rule: Routine new quarterly vintages do not reopen the bilateral Accounting Spine. Aggregate reference-mode observability is already complete.

horizons.action_without_topology_change: Do not rerun exhausted historical source probes.
horizons.action_if_trigger: Preregister a new bilateral Accounting Spine source-topology pass only; aggregate reference-mode readiness remains separately complete.

horizons.source_class: BNR National Financial Accounts annual counterpart stock publication / machine-readable counterpart table
horizons.trigger: An official 2025 year-end non-consolidated S121×counterpart AF4/F4 asset-stock matrix becomes available with exact counterpart sectors sufficient to allocate the retained 6.1 million RON BNR F4 asset stock without residual shares, interpolation or missing-to-zero assumptions.
horizons.action_before_evidence_window: Do not poll repeatedly or infer a publication date from prior-year cadence. Remain on Accounting Spine evidence-triggered hold.
horizons.action_if_no_new_official_evidence_after: Record nonconfirmation only; do not treat it as source absence and do not reopen F4.
horizons.action_if_trigger: Preregister and open F4 stock-only exact counterpart materialization gate. Flow, aggregate reference-mode readiness, calibration, feedback activation and behavioural closure remain unchanged unless separately authorized.
nonreopen_routes: ECB RAS reserve-template F4 series with S1Q counterpart aggregation, foreign-currency-only scope and nominal valuation
ECB BSI subtraction from financial-accounts MFI F4 without an exact concept bridge
routine QSA refresh with unchanged counterpart topology

reopen_prerequisites: A changed official ECB/Eurostat/BNR/OECD dataset topology or genuinely new official source satisfies the accounting_counterpart_topology trigger.
A new bilateral Accounting Spine source-topology pass is preregistered before live acquisition is treated as current scientific work.
The frozen RMD sector/instrument/stock/transaction boundary remains unchanged unless separately reviewed and authorized.
counterpart_probe_execution_boundary.rationale: The 19 September OECD/Eurostat contracts are retained as immutable historical preregistrations. Their executable workflows remain useful for reproducibility, but the current canonical horizon has exhausted those public source boundaries. A manual rerun against unchanged topology is therefore replay evidence only and cannot itself reopen the Accounting Spine.

execution_sequence: A genuinely new official source/transport clue satisfying one frozen reopen condition is identified outside repeated polling.
Dispatch only the minimum read-only or discovery workflow needed to verify the new evidence against frozen identity rules.
Only after positive identity/provenance verification may a write-capable recovery/promotion workflow retain new exact bytes.
Rematerialise only the affected month/version and rerun the frozen partial/full-year gates.
Do not promote the canonical full-year reference mode until all required source coverage and existing scientific gates pass.
